help.text:
Nuclei is a fast, template based vulnerability scanner focusing
on extensive configurability, massive extensibility and ease of use.

Usage:
  nuclei [flags]

Flags:
COMMON:
   -mt, -max-time value  maximum time to run before automatic termination (e.g., 1h, 30m)

TARGET:
   -u, -target string[]          target URLs/hosts to scan
   -l, -list string              path to file containing a list of target URLs/hosts to scan (one per line)
   -targets-inline string        inline multiline target list (for use in template profiles)
   -eh, -exclude-hosts string[]  hosts to exclude to scan from the input list (ip, cidr, hostname)
   -resume string                resume scan from and save to specified file (clustering will be disabled)
   -sa, -scan-all-ips            scan all the IP's associated with dns record
   -iv, -ip-version string[]     IP version to scan of hostname (4,6) - (default 4)

TARGET-FORMAT:
   -im, -input-mode string         mode of input file (list, burp, jsonl, yaml, openapi, swagger) (default "list")
   -ro, -required-only             use only required fields in input format when generating requests
   -sfv, -skip-format-validation   skip format validation (like missing vars) when parsing input file
   -vtt, -vars-text-templating     enable text templating for vars in input file (only for yaml input mode)
   -vfp, -var-file-paths string[]  list of yaml file contained vars to inject into yaml input

TEMPLATES:
   -nt, -new-templates                    run only new templates added in latest nuclei-templates release
   -ntv, -new-templates-version string[]  run new templates added in specific version
   -as, -automatic-scan                   automatic web scan using wappalyzer technology detection to tags mapping
   -t, -templates string[]                list of template or template directory to run (comma-separated, file)
   -turl, -template-url string[]          template url or list containing template urls to run (comma-separated, file)

-interactions-poll-duration.help: number of seconds to wait before each interaction poll request (default 5)

-irr.help: include request/response pairs in the JSON, JSONL, and Markdown outputs (for findings only) [DEPRECATED use -omit-raw] (default true)

-iserver.help: interactsh server url for self-hosted instance (default: oast.pro,oast.live,oast.site,oast.online,oast.fun,oast.me)

-it.help: path to template file or directory to be executed even if they are excluded either by default or configuration

-itags.help: tags to be executed even if they are excluded either by default or configuration

-itoken.help: authentication token for self-hosted interactsh server

-iv.help: IP version to scan of hostname (4,6) - (default 4)

-je.help: file to export results in JSON format

-jle.help: file to export results in JSONL(ine) format

-jsc.help: maximum number of javascript runtimes to be executed in parallel (default 120)

-l.help: path to file containing a list of target URLs/hosts to scan (one per line)

-ldf.help: list all supported DSL function signatures

-lfa.help: allows file (payload) access anywhere on the system

-lna.help: blocks connections to the local / private network

-me.help: directory to export results in markdown format

-mhe.help: max errors for a host before skipping from scan (default 30)

-mp.help: port to expose nuclei metrics on (default 9092)

-mr.help: max number of redirects to follow for http templates (default 10)

-mt.help: maximum time to run before automatic termination (e.g., 1h, 30m)

-nc.help: disable output content coloring (ANSI escape codes)

-nh.help: disable httpx probing for non-url input

-ni.help: disable interactsh server for OAST testing, exclude OAST based templates

-nm.help: disable printing result metadata in cli output

-nmhe.help: disable skipping host from scan based on errors

-nss.help: disable strict syntax check on templates

-nt.help: run only new templates added in latest nuclei-templates release

-ntv.help: run new templates added in specific version

-o.help: output file to write found issues/vulnerabilities

-omit-raw.help: include request/response pairs in the JSON, JSONL, and Markdown outputs (for findings only) [DEPRECATED use -omit-raw] (default true)

-or.help: omit request/response pairs in the JSON, JSONL, Markdown, and PDF outputs (for findings only)

-ot.help: omit encoded template in the JSON, JSONL output

-out.help: output js file with declarations of all global functions

-p.help: list of http/socks5 proxy to use (comma separated or file input)

-page-timeout.help: seconds to wait for each page in headless mode (default 20)

-passive.help: enable passive HTTP response processing mode

-pc.help: max payload concurrency for each template (default 25)

-pd.help: upload / view nuclei results in projectdiscovery cloud (pdcp) UI dashboard

-pdu.help: upload / view nuclei results file (jsonl) in projectdiscovery cloud (pdcp) UI dashboard

-pe.help: file to export results in PDF format

-per-host-rate-limit.help: enable per-host rate limiting (global rate limit becomes unlimited when enabled)

-preflight-portscan.help: run preflight resolve + TCP portscan and filter targets before scanning (disabled by default)

-project.help: use a project folder to avoid sending same request multiple times

-ps.help: prefetch secrets from the secrets file

-pt.help: templates to run based on protocol type. Possible values: dns, file, http, headless, tcp, workflow, ssl, websocket, whois, code, javascript

-r.help: file containing resolver list for nuclei

-rd.help: redact given list of keys from query parameter, request header and body

-rdb.help: nuclei reporting database (always use this to persist report data)

-reset.help: reset removes all nuclei configuration and data files (including nuclei-templates)

-resume.help: resume scan from and save to specified file (clustering will be disabled)

-retries.help: number of times to retry a failed request (default 1)

-rl.help: maximum number of requests to send per second (default 150)

-rld.help: maximum number of requests to send per second (default 1s)

-rlm.help: maximum number of requests to send per minute (DEPRECATED)

-ro.help: use only required fields in input format when generating requests

-rsr.help: max response size to read in bytes

-rss.help: max response size to read in bytes (default 1048576)

-s.help: templates to run based on severity. Possible values: info, low, medium, high, critical, unknown

-sa.help: scan all the IP's associated with dns record

-sb.help: show the browser on the screen when running templates with headless mode

-sc.help: use local installed Chrome browser instead of nuclei installed

-se.help: file to export results in SARIF format

-sf.help: path to config file containing secrets for nuclei authenticated scan

-sfv.help: skip format validation (like missing vars) when parsing input file

-shp.help: suppress output for flagged honeypot hosts

-si.help: number of seconds to wait between showing a statistics update (default 5)

-sid.help: upload scan results to existing scan id (optional)

-sign.help: signs the templates with the private key defined in NUCLEI_SIGNATURE_PRIVATE_KEY env variable

-sip.help: source ip address to use for network scan

-sml.help: show match lines for file templates, works with extractors only

-sni.help: tls sni hostname to use (default: input domain name)

-spm.help: stop processing HTTP requests after the first match (may break template/workflow logic)

-sr.help: use system DNS resolving as error fallback

-srd.help: store all request/response passed through nuclei to custom directory (default "output")

-sresp.help: store all request/response passed through nuclei to output directory

-ss.help: strategy to use while scanning(auto/host-spray/template-spray) (default auto)

-stats.help: display statistics about the running scan

-stream.help: stream mode - start elaborating without sorting the input

-t.help: list of template or template directory to run (comma-separated, file)

-tags.help: templates to run based on tags (comma-separated, file)

-targets-inline.help: inline multiline target list (for use in template profiles)

-tc.help: templates to run based on expression condition

-te.help: adds given error to max-host-error watchlist (standard, file)

-tid.help: upload scan results to given team id (optional) (default "none")

-timeout.help: time to wait in seconds before timeout (default 10)

-tl.help: list all templates matching current filters

-tlc.help: maximum number of concurrent template loading operations (default 50)

-tlog.help: file to write sent requests trace log

-tlsi.help: enable experimental client hello (ja3) tls randomization

-tp.help: template profile config file to run

-ts.help: enables printing timestamp in cli output

-turl.help: template url or list containing template urls to run (comma-separated, file)

-tv.help: shows the version of the installed nuclei-templates

-ud.help: custom directory to install / update nuclei-templates

-up.help: update nuclei engine to the latest released version

-ur.help: override ratelimit of engines with unknown ratelimit (default 60 req/min) (default 60)

-ut.help: update nuclei-templates to latest released version

-validate.help: validate the passed templates to nuclei

-vdl.help: limit the number of characters displayed in var dump (default 255)

-vfp.help: list of yaml file contained vars to inject into yaml input

-vtt.help: enable text templating for vars in input file (only for yaml input mode)

-w.help: list of workflow or workflow directory to run (comma-separated, file)

-wurl.help: workflow url or list containing workflow urls to run (comma-separated, file)

-ztls.help: use ztls library with autofallback to standard one for tls13 [Deprecated] autofallback to ztls is enabled by default
